name: flowmoney-ai
description: FlowMoney AI — WhatsApp-first AI financial copilot with a deterministic financial engine.

scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/**" build && pnpm --filter @flowmoney/api build && pnpm --filter @flowmoney/worker build && pnpm --filter @flowmoney/web build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c cyan,magenta,green "pnpm --filter @flowmoney/api dev" "pnpm --filter @flowmoney/worker dev" "pnpm --filter @flowmoney/web dev"
scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm db:generate && pnpm build:packages
